The valuation of Prudent Corporate Advisory Services Ltd (PRUDENT) appears significantly rich compared to its peers and intrinsic value estimates. The P/E ratio stands at an elevated level of 50.1x [E1], which is notably higher than the sector benchmark of 19.65x [E6]. Similarly, the Price-to-Book (P/B) ratio of 16.15x [E2] and EV/EBITDA multiple of 34.78x [E11] are also well above the respective sector benchmarks of 2.12x and 13.99x, indicating a high valuation relative to peers. Furthermore, a discounted cash flow analysis suggests an intrinsic value of Rs 2322 per share against the current market price of Rs 2859 [E40], resulting in a margin of safety of -23.1% [E41]. This implies that the stock is currently overvalued and does not offer sufficient cushion for potential downturns or changes in earnings outlook. Conceded: The stock's position within its 52-week range at 75% [E5] suggests it has already appreciated significantly, which could indicate that much of the positive sentiment is already priced into the stock.
